title: Staff GTM Data Scientist
description:
The Opportunity

As a Staff Data Scientist at PandaDoc, you will serve as a senior analytical leader, embedding yourself deeply in our product and business data to uncover non-obvious insights and drive actionable recommendations. A primary focus of this strategic role is to champion and drive the organizational shift toward a data-driven culture. You will own the advancement of our experimentation capabilities, train other analysts and data scientists on causal methodologies, and leverage your expertise to provide leadership with a clear, reliable understanding of true impact and causality.

You will report to the Director of Product Data and act as a strategic thought partner to Product, Finance, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment between data insights and critical business decisions.

What You'll DoExperimentation & Causal Strategy
 * Lead the Experimentation Roadmap: Define, champion, and execute a strategic roadmap for measuring impact across PandaDoc, focusing on high-leverage business questions related to customer workflows, churn risk, and long-term value (LTV).
 * Advanced Experiment Design: Design, implement, and rigorously analyze complex A/B tests, multivariate experiments, and adaptive experimentation methods, including the application of Bayesian experimentation, to assess the effectiveness of proposed product changes and business levers.
 * Causal Inference Beyond A/B: Apply advanced causal inference techniques (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching, and instrumental variables) to scenarios where randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are infeasible.
 * Deep Dive Analysis: Conduct complex, proactive, and exploratory analysis to discover latent user behavior, emerging trends, and root causes of changes in key metrics, translating these findings into actionable product and business insights.
 * Develop Measurement Frameworks: Define, instrument, and govern a unified Key Performance Indicator (KPI) framework that maps low-level product health metrics to high-level business outcomes, ensuring consistent and scalable measurement across the organization.

Technical Leadership & Influence
 * Scaling Data Science: Partner with Data Engineering to design and build scalable, self-serve experimentation tooling and reusable analytical assets and frameworks (e.g., causal machine learning models) that empower other analysts and data consumers.
 * Strategic Influence: Act as a strategic thinker by translating complex statistical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable business narratives for cross-functional partners and senior leadership (VP/C-suite), driving strategic decisions and investment priorities.
 * Mentorship and Training: Serve as a technical subject matter expert, training and mentoring junior and mid-level data scientists on best practices in statistical rigor, experimental design, and causal modeling.

About YouQualifications
 * Experience: 6+ years of professional experience in an applied data science, economics, or product analytics role, with a proven track record of leveraging experimentation and causal inference methods to drive significant business impact.
 * Education: B.A. or B.S. in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. A Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Data Science, Econometrics, Operations Research) is preferred, but not required.

Required Technical Expertise
 * Causal Inference: Demonstrated expertise in applying a wide range of Causal Inference methods, e.g. Quasi-Experimentation, Matching Methods (PSM), Difference-in-Differences, and/or Instrumental Variables.
 * Experimentation Methodologies: Expertise in advanced statistical methodologies for A/B testing, including sample size calculations, sequential testing, dealing with interference/network effects, variance reduction techniques (e.g., CUPED), etc.
 * Deep Analytical Methods: Mastery of advanced statistical modeling, time-series analysis, and quantitative methods necessary to perform thorough exploratory data analysis, produce timely insights, and provide actionable recommendations.
 * Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python or R for statistical modeling, with experience using relevant data science packages (e.g., SciKit-Learn, numpy, pandas).
 * Data Tools: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and experience working with established data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Postgres).
 * Data Pipelining: Experience with data transformation and workflow management tools such as dbt, Airflow, or Databricks is a strong plus.

Key Attributes
 * Strategic Communication & Influence: Possesses exceptional communication, presentation, and data storytelling skills with a consistent record of influencing cross-functional partners and leadership at all levels, particularly in navigating and driving consensus in unstructured or ambiguous environments.
 * Change Management: Proven ability to drive organizational change management in environments where experimentation and data-driven decision-making are not yet widely adopted.
 * Thrive in ambiguity: Ability to navigate significant ambiguity, translate complex business questions into clear analytical frameworks, and manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 * Relevant Experience: Experience in a SaaS domain and a strong focus on Product Data Science are strongly preferred.

Company Culture: 
 * We're known for our work-life balance, kind co-workers, & creative virtual team-bonding events. And although our Pandas are located across the globe, we stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on our team feels, well, like a team.
 * Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers. 
 * Check out our LinkedIn to learn more. 

Benefits:
 * Our benefits include tremendous career growth opportunities, a competitive salary, health and commuter benefits, company paid life & disability, 20+ PTO days, 401K and FSA plans, and of course, a fun team of Pandas to work with!

PandaDoc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal treatment of all employees without regard to race, national origin, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, physical or mental disability or other basis protected by law.

title: AI Engineer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students globally.

We are building a future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy, and benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of 60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally.

This is your chance to be part of building a generational company.

YOUR MISSION

You have the opportunity to shape how students learn in the future

Engineering is at the core of the company, it really drives knowunity, main character, you can end to end own this revolution yourself across parts such as:


 * Videos
 * First ones that build video on large scale truly personalised
 * Topic prediction, real guidance / personalisation as biggest opportunity in AI
 * Holy grail is personalisation and guidance, we have a lot of data, you can crack that
 * Future of practice, quizlet is outdated, practice in future needs to be more guided and diverse
 * Multi-Modality of outputs
 * We do not believe in wall of text, we are building cards, graphs, interactive practice elements in the chat - no one has solved this yet
 * New ways of learning of Gen Alpha
 * Figure out how this generation learns
 * In a world of personal AI companions, there will still be in person learning and interaction, how can an AI companion include social use cases and still bring students together
 * Ability to ship A/B tests to millions of users quickly
   
   

Your ownership:


 * Own and build end-to-end AI products that deliver measurable value to students across our global user base.
 * Drive technical decisions that align with product impact - choosing the right tools, models, and approaches to move key metrics like DAU and retention.
 * Translate product ideas into real features by collaborating cross-functionally and contributing actively to product strategy.
   
   

Why this matters: Every AI feature you build gets shipped fast and used by real students - meaning your work has an immediate and measurable effect on learning outcomes, user growth, and product-market fit. You’ll be directly accelerating our core business metrics and impact on students worldwide.

What success looks like: You’ll ship meaningful AI-driven features quickly and iterate based on real usage data. Your technical contributions will be visible in the metrics, boosting usage, retention, and engagement. You’ll help shape a product that students rely on every day, while growing your skills in a team that values speed, autonomy, and ownership. Over time, you’ll be known for building solutions that are not only technically sound, but that truly matter to our mission.

Our Tech Stack

Our app is written in Flutter with Riverpod. Our Golang backend is powered by PostgreSQL and hosted on AWS with Kubernetes. Our AI stack consists of several LLM providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, and Mistral), custom routing engines, and fine-tuned models. Our data stack consists of BigQuery and dbt.

Who You Are

Your mindset

You’re the type of person who:


 * Thinks in prompts and systems - you know how to speak the language of LLMs and can make them do what others can’t
 * Builds to ship - you love moving fast, testing ideas in code, and iterating quickly based on real feedback
 * Serves the user, not the process - you focus relentlessly on impact, not bureaucracy
 * Thrives in ambiguity - when priorities shift, you don’t stall—you adapt and move
 * Leverages AI - as a force multiplier in everything you do
 * Values excellence over comfort - mediocrity isn’t in your vocabulary
   
   

Your track record

You’ve worked hands-on with large language models, tuning prompts, integrating APIs, building prototypes, and pushing performance. You’ve shipped code in real-world products and know how to balance speed with quality. You’ve helped turn messy ideas into useful features that delight users and scale with smart engineering.

Must-haves


 * Experience working with LLMs and strong prompt engineering instincts
 * Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Go, TypeScript, Python)
 * Fluent English; German is a plus
   
   

What we offer

Not for everyone, everything for the right ones.


 * Competitive compensation and equity: We’re are building Knowunity to dominate the global AI learning market. Your compensation package includes competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential. Team members who help us reach that goal will be rewarded accordingly.
 * Elite team and true ownership: You’ll work alongside 60 exceptional people who match your ambition within a flat hierarchy - direct access to founders and leadership without bureaucratic middle layers. You'll own entire areas from conception to delivery with real decision-making authority.
 * Meaningful impact at scale: Your work will have immediate, measurable impact on education globally and directly improves how millions of students learn.
 * Benefits: 28 days annual leave +1 extra day per year with Knowunity, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support via Nilo, Urban Sports Club, monthly become1 retail vouchers, team and company events
   
   

We’re not here to coast - we are building something exceptional. We’re a lean team of ambitious people who push hard, move fast, and constantly raise the bar. The real perk is not standard benefits - it’s joining 60 amazing people who challenge you to level up daily. If you’re hungry, thrive under pressure and ready to go the extra mile, this is where you will accelerate your career faster than anywhere else.

NEXT STEPS

Ready to help build the AI learning unicorn?

Click “Apply for this job” and submit your CV and LinkedIn profile.

We encourage applications from exceptional talent regardless of traditional background requirements.

At Knowunity, we actively foster an inclusive and diverse workplace that ensures equal opportunity for all qualified applicants, regardless of nationality, ethnic or national origin, skin color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or marital status. Please refrain from including your picture and age with the application.

 * World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
   
   

Your Impact

As a data science consultant at QuantumBlack, you will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for organizations globally. You will influence many of the recommendations our clients need to positively change their businesses and enhance performance.

In this role, you will be responsible for working on complex and extremely varied data sets from some of the world’s largest organizations to solve real-world problems. You will develop high-quality data science products and solutions for clients as well as assets for our internal data teams, focusing on modeling and working alongside the Data Engineering team. Additionally, you will present findings, recommendations, and provide consultation to stakeholders, both internal and clients.

Throughout your tenure, you will learn to work across various industries and sectors, gaining insights into diverse business challenges and applications of data science. You will build large-scale data and analytics solutions, handling complex problems and advanced client situations. You will also learn best practices in data and analytics development, including framework, responsibility model, high-quality code, data security, sustainability, and scalability. Working in collaborative teams with diverse skill sets, you will foster effective teamwork and learn from colleagues in a multicultural and creative environment. Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science tools, techniques, and technologies, as well as participating in first-class learning programs, will be a key part of your development. You will also develop strong client-facing skills, including effective communication, problem-solving, and presentation abilities.

You will work with other data scientists, data/ML engineers, designers, project managers, and business subject matter experts on interdisciplinary projects across various industry sectors to enable business ambitions with data and analytics.

#STEM2025

Your Qualifications and Skills

title: Operations Manager (m/f/x)
description:
We are looking for an Operations Manager (m/f/x) to support us in our mission with immediate effect. In this role, you will work in close collaboration with the Head of Operations and support operational excellence across the entire organization by establishing, improving, and maintaining clear (and wherever possible automated) processes, structures, and ways of working.

You will play a central role in supporting efficient, transparent operations that are aligned with the company's strategic goals. By supporting the development and continuous optimization of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating models, and cross-functional processes, you will help enable teams to focus on what matters most: delivering high-quality digital health solutions to patients.

In addition, you will support strategic planning processes by coordinating quarterly OKRs and annual goals, tracking progress, and helping ensure alignment across departments. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, leadership, and all functional teams to enable data-driven decision-making, effective communication, and smooth execution of company-wide processes.

This is a highly impactful role at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, offering the opportunity to actively contribute to how Cara Care works today and how it scales in the future.

Your Responsibilities

Operational Excellence and Process Optimization


 * Support operational excellence and organization-wide alignment by helping establish, improve, and maintain clear and scalable processes and operating models, and actively engaging teams to adopt them in daily operations
 * Support the preparation and facilitation of Operations-led meetings and communication formats, ensuring clear agendas, actionable outcomes, and reliable follow-up
 * Support the administration and continuous improvement of key company tools, including security, scalability, and efficient usage
   
   

Strategic Planning and Cross-Functional Support


 * Support the planning, coordination, and execution of quarterly OKRs and annual goals, monitoring progress and highlighting risks or dependencies
 * Support the definition, tracking, and interpretation of key operational metrics and KPIs to enable data-driven decision-making
 * Work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams as an operational sparring partner, supporting hands-on projects and technical implementations/automations (e.g., HubSpot, Typeform, Google Sheets)
   
   

Requirements

Your Profile


 * 2+ years of experience in Operations or a related field, with hands-on responsibility for company-wide and/or team-level processes, coordination, or cross-functional initiatives
 * Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and drive topics to completion
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German, with the ability to clearly communicate operational topics, engage people, and align diverse stakeholders
 * High digital affinity; experience with Google Workspace, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), and HubSpot is a plus
 * Ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining strong attention to detail
 * A reliable, precise, and solution-oriented working style
 * High level of independence and a hands-on mentality
 * Curiosity and motivation to work in the fast-growing and evolving field of digital therapeutics
   
   

💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

In return you will have


 * 💸 Fair Compensation: We offer a competitive salary with regular reviews, plus the best equipment to help you do your best work
 * 🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, collaborative working atmosphere— complete with regular on-sight team events
 * 👨‍💻 Remote-first work setup: Whether you prefer working from home or from our office in Berlin, the choice is yours. We support a truly flexible remote-first work model
 * 🏝️ 30 days off per year: We believe in the power of rest. That's why we offer 30 days off per year—including 4 company-wide mental health days on top of 26 vacation days
 * 🦉Flexible working hours: Early bird or night owl? Work the hours that suit you best
 * 🚀 Real Impact: Your work matters. You'll play a key role in shaping the future direction of our company and product
   
   

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to bring holistic, science-backed support to people with digestive issues. Through our app, individuals can identify symptom triggers, receive personalized recommendations, and access digital therapeutic programs for:


 * Irritable Bowel Syndrome (Cara Care for IBS)
 * Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Cara Care for IBD)
 * Heartburn (Cara Care for Heartburn)
   
   

Our IBS program is officially approved by the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM) as a reimbursable digital health application (DiGA)—a first in its field.

Backed by Bayer

We're proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer's global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we're poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It's Like To Work With Us

At Cara Care, you'll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We're inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That's why we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We're excited to get to know you!

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About The Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Data Scientist to join our Operations and Customer Service department. You will be instrumental in developing advanced AI models that enhance both internal operational workflows and customer-facing experiences. This includes building systems that help our Curation team verify product quality and authenticity from customer-provided descriptions and images, as well as exploring and delivering new models aimed at improving how customers interact with our platform. The role requires strong end-to-end machine learning expertise and a user-centric mindset to drive measurable improvements in accuracy, operational efficiency, and overall customer experience.

What you will do



 * Design and own end-to-end AI/ML solutions for item quality and authenticity detection, spanning:Image analysis (detecting marks, defects, wear, size inconsistencies)
 * T ext and metadata understanding (brand, sizing, category anomalies)
 * Counterfeit and fraud detection modelsDesign, prototype, and iterate on AI models that directly power and improve customer-facing experiences on our platform (e.g., smarter assistance)
 * Collaborate closely with the Product and Curation teams to define requirements, integrate AI models into their workflow, and provide insights to enhance their verification processes
 * Advise and direct data/feedback collection for continuous improvement and monitoring of the performance of the models
 * Perform rigorous model evaluation, A/B testing, and continuous improvement of AI models
 * Work with engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and integration of AI models into our existing platforms
 * Research and stay updated on the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, deep learning and computer vision to identify new opportunities and best practices
 * Mentor senior and mid-level data scientists, raising the technical bar on modeling, data quality, and experimentation best practices
 * Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
   
   
   
   

Who you are



 * 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning engineering, or AI development, with a strong focus on computer vision applications and customer facing models
 * Deep expertise in applied AI/ML (computer vision, anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling).Track record of leading technical initiatives and influencing decisions across teams
 * Experience in architecturing, deploying, and maintaining AI systems at scale
 * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and experience with relevant libraries/frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, TorchServe, TensorflowServing, PyTorch, scikit-learn, spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenCV)
 * Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling, and data manipulation techniques
 * Experience with data visualization tools and communicating insights effectively
 * Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous problems
 * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global team environment
 * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and MLOps practices is a plus
 * Experience building or maintaining customer service chatbot systems is a plus
 * Familiarity with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL) and cloud data warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake)
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 * Fluency in written and spoken English (please send your application in ENGLISH only)
   
   
   
   

Our Tech Stacks includes

Deep Learning & ML frameworks & Libraries: PyTorch, Tensorflow, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, TorchServe, TensorflowServing

Model serving: Airflow, Torchserve, TFServing, Triton Inference Server, REST APIs, gRPC

Deployment: K8s

What we offer 🎁

A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability

The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up

The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities

Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association

Significant investment in your learning and growth

Competitive Compensation And Benefits Package
Research indicates that people from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities—often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every single requirement.

At Vestiaire Collective, we believe that talent comes in many forms, and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Your unique perspective could be exactly what our team needs, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every box.

Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunities employer
Beware of Scams
Vestiaire Collective only contacts candidates via official emails ending in @vestiairecollective.com or no-reply@hire.lever.co . We never use WhatsApp, Telegram, or similar apps for job offers, nor will we ever request payments or banking details.

If you receive a suspicious message, please report it to talentacquisition@vestiairecollective.com

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: MBB Consultant - AI Consulting Simulation & Evaluation
description:
Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka's deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are now launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are building a team of former McKinsey, BCG, and Bain consultants who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a team of ex-McKinsey and Bain consultants shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with MBB experience (McKinsey, BCG, or Bain). If you do not have direct experience at one of these firms, please do not apply. This requirement is non-negotiable and helps us ensure the domain is built by practitioners with firsthand MBB training and standards.

Who We're Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group, or Bain & Company.

You should have hands-on project experience:


 * Structuring ambiguous client problems
 * Building models and synthesized findings
 * Producing client-ready deliverables
 * Forming recommendations under uncertainty
   
   

No deep technical background required, we'll onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You'll Do


 * Build realistic consulting project environments: create detailed project scenarios (industry context, financials, constraints, incomplete information)
 * Design structured consulting tasks for AI Agents: break projects into tasks that mirror real consulting work such as market sizing, due diligence, cost reduction, growth strategy, or operational diagnosis
 * Define evaluation criteria and quality standards: develop a grading approach, evaluation criteria and golden solutions for each task that will be used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale
   
   

This is a remote individual-contributor project-based role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements


 * 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, or Bain
 * Strong structured problem-solving skills
 * Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps
 * High attention to logical consistency
 * Independent working style
 * Clear written English (B2+)

Du startest mit einer 32h Woche mit der Möglichkeit von Homeoffice, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten um eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance zu ermöglichenDu kannst bei uns aktiv dazu beitragen einen nachhaltigen Fußabdruck zu hinterlassen und gleichzeitig dein Karma-Konto auffüllenTanke neue Energie und sammle unvergessliche Erinnerungen – profitiere von bis zu 37 Tagen Freizeit im Jahr, bestehend aus entspannendem Urlaub und die Möglichkeit auf zusätzliche Erholungstage Ein steuervergünstigtes BVG-Ticket, After-Work & Team-Events (z.B. unser berühmt berüchtigter Happy Thursday, Unternehmensfeiern, gemeinsame Dinner zu gegebenen Anlässen, Action- und Workshop-Days), betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits etc.Eine wettbewerbsgerechte Vergütung mit attraktivem Fixum und variablem AnteilEin intensives Onboarding, vielseitige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit durch einen unbefristeten ArbeitsvertragEin internationales und herzliches Team, das sich sowohl während der Arbeit als auch danach gut versteht und es kaum erwarten kann, dich kennenzulernen

In der Welt des Re-Commerce von Consumer Electronics haben wir uns nicht nur in Deutschland an die Spitze gekämpft, sondern setzen nun auch unsere internationalen Ambitionen um. Unser täglicher Antrieb ist nicht nur geschäftlicher Natur, sondern vor allem von einem tiefen Umweltbewusstsein geprägt. Durch unsere nachhaltige Arbeitsweise konnten wir bereits zahlreiche Tonnen an CO2-Emissionen einsparen – ein Versprechen an die Erde, das wir leidenschaftlich verfolgen.

Unsere Devise lautet: 'Es muss nicht immer neu sein.' Damit wollen wir unsere geschätzten Kund:innen nicht nur auf qualitativ hochwertige Elektronikprodukte aufmerksam machen, sondern auch das Bewusstsein für Nachhaltigkeit und den verantwortungsbewussten Konsum fördern. Mit unseren Produkten bieten wir eine grüne Alternative, die gleichermaßen die Umwelt schützt und das Budget entlastet.

Unsere Vision ist es, gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen eine nachhaltige und umweltbewusste Zukunft zu gestalten, in der wir nicht nur an unsere technologischen Bedürfnisse denken, sondern auch an die Bedürfnisse unseres Planeten. Wir sind stolz darauf, Marktführer im Re-Commerce zu sein und unser Engagement für die Erde auf internationalem Terrain auszubauen. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Welt ein Stückchen grüner machen.

About Us

At Cloover, our mission is to empower 1 billion people to become part of the sustainable world of tomorrow by providing hassle-free access to renewable energy at the click of a button. Join the race to achieve Net Zero and enable everyone to play a role in the energy transition.

We aim to make sustainable financing simpler, faster, and more affordable, bringing renewable energy to every household and business.

We are on an exciting growth journey, currently operating in the Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland, and Germany, with plans to expand to additional European markets in the coming year.

title: Data Scientist Marketing
description:

 * Du hast die Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Geschäftsreisen.
   
   

Die Rolle erfordert Deutschkenntnisse von (nachgewiesen) mindestens C1

Das bieten wir Dir


 * Data & AI im Kern: Dich erwarten vielfältige und anspruchsvolle Projekte mit namhaften Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen – von datengetriebenen Lösungen bis hin zu innovativen KI-Anwendungen
 * Fachliche Vielfalt & Entwicklung: Du arbeitest an komplexen, abwechslungsreichen Fragestellungen und baust dabei kontinuierlich deine Expertise in deinem Fachgebiet sowie im Umfeld von Data & AI aus
 * Professionelle Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine methodische, fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung – durch regelmäßiges Feedback, individuelle Förderung, Weiterbildungsangebote und unser Mentoring-Programm
 * Kultur & Zusammenarbeit: Dich erwartet ein offenes, diverses und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem starken Teamgefühl
 * Moderne Arbeitsweise: Wir leben eine iterative, moderne Arbeitskultur mit klarer Kommunikation, Eigenverantwortung und Raum für neue Ideen und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten
 * Transparente Vergütung: Wir bieten faire, strukturierte und nachvollziehbare Gehaltsstufen, die regelmäßig an Markt- und Leistungsentwicklungen angepasst werden
 * Flexibles Arbeiten: Unser modernes Office in Frankfurt ist dein zentraler Arbeitsort – gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig remote zu arbeiten und bis zu vier Wochen pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten
 * Mobilität & Gesundheit: Profitiere von einem ermäßigten Deutschlandticket und vergünstigtem Zugang zu Sport- und Wellnessangeboten über Wellpass
 * Ausstattung & Extras: Hochwertiges IT-Equipment (z. B. MacBook Pro), regelmäßige Team-Events sowie zusätzliche Leistungen wie Kinderbetreuungszuschüsse und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte runden dein Gesamtpaket ab

Was für uns besonders wichtig ist: Wir schätzen die Einzigartigkeit jedes Menschen und begegnen einander stets auf Augenhöhe. title: Data Scientist
description:
We are now looking for a

Data Scientist

located in our office in Berlin, Hamburg or Hohenwarte.

As a Data Scientist, you will transform complex datasets into meaningful, actionable insights. You will work hands-on with our data platform, build analytical solutions, and partner closely with business teams, Data Engineers, Architects, and fellow Data Scientists. Your work directly supports operational excellence, commercial outcomes, and our long-term sustainability goals.

If you enjoy tackling real-world challenges, asking critical questions, and taking ownership from idea to impact — you will thrive with us.

Your Responsibilities


 * Deliver high-quality analyses and insights that support operational, commercial, and strategic decisions, quality analyses and insights that support operational, commercial, and strategic decisions.
 * Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, embedding yourself in their workflows and understanding their challenges.
 * Communicate insights clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences using strong storytelling skills.
 * Identify and integrate new data sources, features, and analytical methods to enhance our models and insights.
 * Work with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure data quality, availability, and robust solution design.
 * Apply statistical techniques and advanced analytics to uncover patterns, trends, and optimization potential.
 * Create meaningful visualizations, dashboards, and interactive analytical tools.
 * Conduct ad-hoc analyses to support time-sensitive decisions.
 * Ensure data accuracy through validation, documentation, and quality checks.
 * Automate recurring analytics tasks to increase efficiency and reproducibility.
 * Follow data protection regulations and ethical data use practice and protection regulations.
 * Prioritize and manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment.
   
   

Qualifikationen


 * Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
 * Strong practical experience with SQL and Python for end-to-end data processing and analysis; familiarity with distributed computing (e.g. Spark) is beneficial.
 * Solid grasp of statistical methods and their practical application.
 * Strong analytical mindset with the ability to explore data, identify patterns, and derive actionable insights.
 * Understanding of machine learning workflows (feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring) is a plus.
 * Familiarity with front-end frameworks (Angular/React) is a plus but not required.
 * Curiosity about generative AI and automation techniques to accelerate analysis and boost productivity.
 * Interest or experience in energy systems, asset optimization, or energy markets is advantageous.
 * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics for diverse audiences.
 * Strong business acumen - connecting analytical findings to business objectives.
 * Experience with requirements engineering and translating stakeholders needs into actionable specifications for your analysis
 * Collaborative mindset with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.
 * Proactive, solution-oriented approach with high attention to detail.
 * Ability to adapt to changing data sources, priorities, and business needs.
 * Strong time management skills and ability to work independently.
 * Commitment to ethical data practices and data privacy.
   
   

If you meet around 70% of the requirements, we still want to hear from you. We value potential and curiosity. Please be honest about your experiences / qualification. Continuous learning is part of our culture — you don’t need to be perfect on day one.

Zusätzliche Informationen

What We Offer


 * A mission-driven role where your work contributes to the energy transition
 * Competitive compensation (70 – 90 kEUR yearly salary) and a modern, international work environment
 * 37h/week, 30 days of vacation
 * Hybrid work and up to 20 days per year of work-from-abroad
 * Employer-subsidized public transport and JobBike
 * State-of-the-art office spaces
 * Company pension scheme
 * Budget for fitness and health
   
   

More Information

We welcome your application in English no later than, 23.03.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the position, please contact hiring manager Philipp Cüppers via email: philipp.cueppers@vattenfall.de

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Elias Erdmann via email: eliasmaximilian.erdmann@vattenfall.de

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s leading producers and retailers of electricity and heat. With 21,000 employees across Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK, we have been electrifying industries and powering societies for over a century. Today, our mission is clear: working for fossil-freedom.

Within the Business Unit Hydro Power Plants Germany, we operate the country’s largest storage portfolio and play a critical role in balancing short-term power markets. Our pump storage plants provide flexibility and reliability—key enablers of the energy transition.

The Data Innovation team develops and operates a Databricks-based analytics and machine learning platform to deliver actionable insights and support strategic, commercial, and operational decisions. We collaborate closely across the business to improve efficiency, reduce emissions, and accelerate the transition to a sustainable energy system.

title: Head of Quality (m/f/x)
description:
Skeleton's Operations department is looking for a driven and experienced

Head of Quality (m/f/x)

to be the first initiator to develop and provide quality management system assessment processes and prepare us for internal and external audits of our facilities. Using relevant KPIs, you will also set up and execute quality control processes for operational quality management as well as educate Skeleton employees about quality topics.

You will further be involved in the following areas:


 * Develop and implement quality management strategies and policies to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations
 * Develop the company's Quality Management System to ensure it conforms with the customer, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF16949, and regulatory/legal requirements
 * Establish and maintain quality control processes and procedures across all production departments
 * Conduct regular audits to identify areas for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve quality-related issues, implementing corrective and preventive actions as necessary
 * Monitor key performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of quality control measures and drive continuous improvement
 * Lead and mentor a growing cross-border team, divided into several sub-teams, such as Production Quality, Supplier Quality, Incoming Inspection, and others

 * Stay updated on industry trends, regulations, and best practices related to quality management and integrate them into the company's quality processes
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., engineering, quality management, production management) is required. A master's degree is preferred
 * Proven experience in a similar role, preferably in a production environment, with a focus on quality management and auditing
 * Highly recommended to bring experience from managing ESG & Sustainability topics
 * Experience in leading and managing a multinational team, with excellent leadership and interpersonal skills
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to make data-driven decisions
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
 * Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and attention to quality
 * Various ISO, IATF, and standard introductions and certifications are not new to you
 * You have a hands-on work mentality and characterized by regular exchange with the production team
 * You feel very comfortable communicating in German and English, both on a communicative and written level
   
   

Benefits


 * We offer flexible working hours, with the possibility of mobile working without core working hours and sufficient freedom for your own ideas
 * A flat hierarchy culture - fostering our great working atmosphere
 * Helpfulness among colleagues is not just an empty phrase but a practice every day
 * A motivating opportunity for continuous growth at Skeleton
 * An additional day off every year for your birthday
 * Be active & participate in our internal sports challenges (SkelFitness)
 * We celebrate our successes with Team Events, Summer & New Year's parties, and other initiatives!
   
   

We're not just about energy storage. We're about redefining energy for a net zero future, and we'd love for you to be a part of our journey.

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a Global Cleantech 100 company and a technology leader in high power energy storage for transportation, grid, automotive, and industrial applications.

For us, developing and producing the best energy storage solutions is a means to an end: helping companies to reduce CO2 emissions and save energy.

We work with some of the largest companies in the world from automotive and industrial OEMs to truck fleet operators and aerospace prime contractors. Our products decrease CO2 emissions and fuel consumption, improve power quality, and empower wider electrification of the biggest industries globally.

Our supercapacitor and SuperBattery energy storage technologies, based on patented curved graphene, represent the biggest technological advancement in the industry in the last 20 years and the use of this innovative material provides our products with an unparalleled advantage in power and energy density.

Skeleton Technologies is located in multiple locations: headquarters in Tallinn (Estonia), manufacturings in Markranstädt (Germany) and Varkaus (Finland), materials development in Bitterfeld-Wolfen, several additional locations in Finland (Helsinki and Lappeenranta), and an office in Berlin and first people in Toulouse (France).

title: Data Engineer / ML Ops
description:
sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

Join us and play a pivotal role in transforming the automation landscape in heavy industries.

Role Overview:

As our Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure that powers Sensmore’s embodied AI and Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAMs). You’ll collaborate with Robotics, ML and Software engineers to ensure clean, reliable data flows from our sensor arrays (radar, LiDAR, cameras, IMUs) into training and inference pipelines. This role blends classic data engineering (ETL/ELT, warehouse design, monitoring) with ML Ops best practices: model versioning, data drift detection, and automated retraining.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Build & operate data pipelines: Ingest, process, and transform multi-sensor telemetry (radar point-clouds, video frames, log streams) into analytics-ready and ML-ready formats.
 * Design scalable storage: Architect high-throughput, low-latency data lakes and warehouses (e.g., S3, Delta Lake, Redshift/Snowflake).
 * Enable ML Ops workflows: Integrate DVC or MLflow, automate model training/retraining triggers, track data/model lineage.
 * Ensure data quality: Implement validation, monitoring, and alerting to catch anomalies and schema changes early.
 * Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Embedded Systems, Robotics, and Software teams to align on data schemas, APIs, and real-time requirements.
 * Optimize performance: Tune distributed processing, queries, and storage layouts for cost-efficiency and throughput.
 * Document & evangelize: Maintain clear documentation for data schemas, pipeline architectures, and ML Ops practices to uplift the whole team.
   
   

Required Qualifications:


 * 3+ years of hands-on experience building production data pipelines in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
 * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and at least one big-data framework.
 * Familiarity with ML Ops tooling: DVC, MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar.
 * Experience designing and operating data warehouses/data lakes (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Delta Lake).
 * Strong understanding of distributed systems, data serialization (Parquet, Avro), and batch vs. streaming paradigms.
 * Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
   
   

Preferred Skills:


 * Background in robotics or sensor data (radar, LiDAR, camera pipelines).
 * Knowledge of real-time data processing and edge-computing constraints.
 * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data workflows.
 * Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized deployments.
 * Exposure to vision-language or action-planning ML models.
   
   

What we offer:


 * Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task
 * Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors
 * Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment
 * Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead
 * Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment
   
   

Benefits:


 * Attractive compensation package and stock options.
 * Beverages on-site and regular social events.
 * Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders.
 * Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges.
 * Assistance with relocation to Berlin.
   
   

About Us:

Heavy machinery, light years ahead.

sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

We are proudly backed by Point Nine and other Tier 1 investors.

title: (Tech) Analyst
description:
The Role

Fortino Capital is building its next chapter in DACH, and we’re looking for an exceptional Analyst to join our team in Munich.

You’ll work in a small, 6-person venture team with a decade-long track record in investing. You will be part of the team located in Munich, with a Partner and an Investment Manager on the ground. Fortino Ventures has a proven LP base and real momentum - but you will have a true greenfield opportunity: shaping how we invest, source, and win from the ground up - since we have just started investing a freshly raised fund in this new setting.

This is a role for someone who is both deeply curious about technology and genuinely excited about founders, ambition, and early-stage company building.

If you want maximum ownership, steep learning, and real decision leverage, all while breaking into the world of Venture Capital - this is your chance.

 

What You’ll Do

You’ll be deeply involved across the full early-stage investment process, with a strong focus on sourcing and evaluating deals in AI-first B2B software. Responsibilities include

 * Source and evaluate generational early-stage startups and founders all over Europe, with a focus on the DACH and Benelux regions
 * Develop high-conviction theses around emerging themes (AI agents, automation, infrastructure, security, vertical software, etc.)
 * Build sharp founder-level judgment: why now, why this team, why this wins
 * Run founder meetings end-to-end, from first intro through deep dives
 * Build and manage your own deal pipeline with relentless tracking and follow-through
 * Create structured outputs that drive decisions: market maps, competitive landscapes, investment memos
 * Strengthen Fortino’s internal sourcing, screening, and tracking engine - helping us scale and improve how we operate
 * Represent Fortino authentically at events and in the ecosystem, building real founder and investor relationships

 

This role is not about passive research - it’s about building an investment platform and firm with us.

 

What You Bring

We’re looking for someone with exceptional talent, high ambition, and founder-level energy. 

 

You might be a great fit if you have:

 * A top academic background in a business, technical or analytical field (CS, Engineering, Physics, Data/AI, Information Systems, Business, Management, Economics, etc.)
 * Strong grades and evidence of intellectual intensity (intellect is good, but ambition is what makes the difference)
 * A Master’s degree (or equivalent)
 * Ideally ~12 months of full-time experience in a high-performance environment (startup, scaleup, consulting, or technical strategy teams such as QuantumBlack / BCG Gamma / Celonis / Palantir-style roles)
 * Exposure to modern software and AI products - you understand what makes technology real vs. hype
 * The ability to form and articulate independent judgment and clear opinions
 * Strong written and verbal communication
 * Exceptional in creating genuine, authentic, and lasting relationships with people in the ecosystem

 

Technical depth is a plus, but the core is: you can think clearly, learn fast, and engage with founders at eye level.

 

What Matters Most to Us

We care less about buzzwords and more about how you operate:

 * Curiosity + range: you learn new domains fast
 * High-signal thinking: crisp, structured, no-BS judgment
 * Founder empathy: deep respect for builders and what it takes
 * Ownership: you take initiative without waiting for permission
 * Energy + ambition: you raise the bar and the room
 * Opinionated taste: you know what good looks like in products, teams, and markets, and you voice it

 

Why Join Fortino

 * Work directly with senior investors in a super small, high-trust team
 * Real deal responsibility and decision proximity from day one (this is no behind-the-scenes-number-crunching-role)
 * A rare chance to help shape a new VC presence in Munich & Europe
 * Become exceptional at evaluating early-stage AI-first companies
 * Build a network across Europe’s top founders and operators
 * High autonomy, high standards, zero politics
 * Plus: office breaks with Vino, the most playful Vizsla in venture and our VC office dog in Munich

 

Application (Highly Encouraged)

We don’t read cover letters. A CV is enough.

 

To stand out, include short answers (3–5 sentences) to the following:

 1. 2–3 stealth founders or startups in DACH/Benelux we should meet - and why
 2. Your moonshot idea: how would you help Fortino become one of Europe’s most competitive early-stage funds?

 

Real opinions only - no generic or AI-copy-paste answers.

title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Did you know that in-app ads are sold in real-time auctions before they get rendered in thousands of mobile apps? Dozens of ad networks compete for every single view, choosing their best ad and deciding what price to bid in just a couple hundred milliseconds. At adjoe, we are building one of those ad networks, competing against giants like Google and Meta to present our ads to the right users. Whether you are an AdTech veteran or new to the industry, the challenge we face is equally compelling: managing over 10 billion predictions daily to balance advertiser goals, publisher expectations, and user experience.


The adjoe Ads Data Science team is the heart and brain of this operation. We don’t just analyze data; we build the core logic that drives our revenue. Leveraging technologies ranging from linear regression to state-of-the-art Deep Learning (GDCN), we manage the entire bidding lifecycle—including conversion prediction, user quality estimation, and bid shading.


We believe in self-built technology and rapid iteration. Our infrastructure allows us to test new ideas offline and launch A/B tests in production within minutes. As a Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with our Data Scientists, analyzing user behavior and generating insights that help us improve our bidding strategy and shaping the algorithms that define the future of our business.


What you will do:

   
   
 * Analyze usage patterns on the user level to spot inefficiencies of our bidding algorithm, derive new features and work hand in hand with our Data Scientists on improving the different machine learning models.
   
   
 * Compare the real world with the way that the bidding algorithm models the world and guide the team in aligning both.
   
   
 * Build dashboards and email reports to simplify the performance of the models for everyone.
   
   
 * Become a contact person between the business teams and the Data Science team and help them translate requirements and ideas into products.
   
   
 * Document your findings and communicate them to the team.
   
   
 * Prepare calculations for A/B tests launches and analyze experiments results.
   
   
 * Challenge and contribute to product-related decisions based on your insights.
   
   


Who you are:

   
   
 * You have a degree in mathematics, physics, information technology, analytics, or a similar field.
   
   
 * You have 5+ years’ of relevant experience, preferably in AdTech or mobile app companies.
   
   
 * You’re excited to work with data and have experience in extracting business insights from it.
   
   
 * You’re proficient in SQL.
   
   
 * You have a strong knowledge of Python or R.
   
   
 * You know how to perform statistical analyses (e.g. use hypothesis tests to evaluate A/B tests).
   
   
 * You have an excellent understanding of data visualization and have experience building dashboards (e.g. QuickSight, MS PowerBI, Tableau, R Shiny, Streamlit) to showcase analysis results.
   
   
 * You have experience in working with task-tracking tools (Jira, GitLab, etc).
   
   


Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

   
   
 * Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.
   
   
 * Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.
   
   
 * Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   
   
 * Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.
   
   
 * Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.
   
   


Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!


We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Your mission

As our AI Automation Engineer, you will be the driving force behind scaling efficiency at Cosuno. As the expert for Cosuno’s automation stack, you will partner with teams across the company to identify, design, and implement AI-driven workflows that transform their work. Rather than building or training proprietary models from scratch, you will leverage state-of-the-art existing models and reasoning chains to solve business problems.

As part of the product team, you will collaborate closely with the CEO & CTO to ensure all solutions are technically sound and aligned with our core infrastructure. This is an execution-heavy role where success is measured by the speed and reliability of the modular automation platform you build.

Key Responsibilities


 * Discovery & Prioritization: Partner with Finance, Sales, Ops & Product to identify high-ROI automation opportunities & evaluate them based on business impact versus technical effort.
 * Workflow Engineering: Design, prototype, and deploy end-to-end AI workflows by building our orchestration stack (e.g., n8n, Vector Databases) and connecting various endpoints via APIs to build a universal memory for Cosuno.
 * Scaling & Modularity: Build solutions that are modular and reusable across different departments to avoid "reinventing the wheel" for every new request.
 * Enablement & Governance: Establish AI guardrails, while enabling AI champions in other departments to work with the automations themselves.
 * Monitoring & Optimization: Define and track success metrics (ROI, time saved, reliability) to ensure automations deliver continuous value.
   
   

Your profile


 * The "Product" Mindset: You treat internal tools like products. You prioritize ruthlessly and focus on business value over "perfect code” or "beautiful UI”.
 * Technical Fluency: You are proficient in Python, n8n, and API architecture. You have hands-on experience with RAG and connecting LLMs to proprietary data sources.
 * Applied AI Focus: You prefer building “Reasoning Chains” and integrating existing tools over training custom models.
 * Systems Thinker: You see the company as a series of interconnected data flows. You naturally see patterns and build modular solutions that scale across teams.
 * Change Agent: You have experience driving organizational change and can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders with ease.
 * Pragmatic Innovator: You would rather ship a working automation in two weeks than a perfect one in six months, and you have the commercial sense to block non-feasible requests.
   
   

Why us?


 * Applied AI, Not R&D: You won’t spend months training models that never go live. You’ll leverage the modern stack (LLMs, Vector DBs, n8n) to ship high-impact automations that solve real business problems immediately.
 * Uncapped Leverage: Construction is one of the last undigitized global industries. We aren't optimizing ad-clicks; we are building the digital nervous system for the physical world. Your efficiency gains here have a massive multiplier effect.
 * Strategic Ownership: You aren’t hidden in a silo. Collaborating directly with the CEO & CTO, you have the autonomy to identify bottlenecks and build the infrastructure that allows Cosuno to scale.
   
   

About Us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: KI Daten Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Data & AI Engineer (m/w/d)

AI-Fokus | Innovation




In AI-Projekten entscheidet die Qualität der Daten darüber, ob ein System funktioniert oder scheitert. Struktur, Semantik und Zugänglichkeit sind dabei wichtiger als das eigentliche Modell.




Als AI Data Engineer gestaltest du die Datenbasis für AI-Anwendungen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten so aufgebaut sind, dass RAG-Systeme, Agenten und KI-Workflows sinnvoll, stabil und nachvollziehbar damit arbeiten können. Dein Fokus liegt auf Architektur, nicht auf Reporting und nicht auf isolierter Backend-Logik.




Deine Aufgaben

 * Du konzipierst und baust Datenarchitekturen für AI-Projekte – von der Quelle bis zur Nutzung im Modell
 * Du entwickelst Datenbanken und Datenmodelle, die für RAG-Systeme, Agenten und KI-Workflows geeignet sind
 * Du strukturierst, transformierst und integrierst strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten (z. B. Dokumente, PDFs, E-Mails, Wissensbasen)
 * Du bewertest Datenqualität, Datenverfügbarkeit und Datenreife im Kontext konkreter AI-Use-Cases
 * Du arbeitest eng mit AI-Developern zusammen und schaffst die Grundlage für stabile, skalierbare KI-Lösungen
 * Du unterstützt Kunden bei der Entwicklung von Datenstrategien für AI-Anwendungen
 * Du begleitest Workshops und Use-Case-Analysen mit Fokus auf Daten, Machbarkeit und Business Impact
 * Du bringst Best Practices und neue Ansätze rund um Daten, Vektordatenbanken und AI-Architekturen aktiv ein




Dein Profil

 * Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Engineering, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
 * Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung, Datenbanken und Datenpipelines
 * Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken, RAG-Architekturen oder datengetriebenen AI-Systemen
 * Sicherer Umgang mit Python und datenverarbeitenden Frameworks
 * Verständnis dafür, wie LLMs, Embeddings und AI-Anwendungen Daten konsumieren
 * Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – gegenüber Entwicklern wie auch Fachbereichen
 * Strukturierte, analytische Denkweise und Freude daran, komplexe Datenprobleme lösbar zu machen




Bonus, aber kein Muss:

 * Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS)
 * Kenntnisse in n8n, make oder ähnlichen Automatisierungsplattformen
 * Erfahrung mit DevOps-Grundlagen, Docker oder Open-Source-LLMs




Was dich bei uns erwartet

 * Anspruchsvolle AI-Projekte mit realem Business-Bezug
 * Hoher Einfluss auf Architektur, Standards und Vorgehensweisen
 * Selbstorganisation statt Micromanagement
 * Transparenz in Entscheidungen, Zahlen und Strategie
 * Arbeit auf Augenhöhe in interdisziplinären Teams
 * Raum für Mitgestaltung und Verantwortung über das eigene Projekt hinaus




Über uns

Wir entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen Software- und AI-Lösungen in der Metropolregion Nürnberg. Unsere Projekte entstehen in selbstorganisierten Teams mit klarer Verantwortung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Laterale Führung, Selbstorganisation und Mitgestaltung prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Deine Meinung zählt und du wirst bei Entscheidungen nicht allein gelassen.




Auf diese Stelle bewerben

Wenn du AI-Projekte dort stärken willst, wo ihre Basis liegt, dann freuen wir uns auf den Austausch!

title: Engineering Manager - Data & ML Platform (m/f/d)
description:
Company Description

Flink is the leading quick commerce player in Europe. We are on a mission to give people back time: You can order your groceries through our app and we deliver to your doorstep in minutes. To power our next phase of growth, we are looking for an exceptional Engineering Manager (m/f/d) to lead and scale our core Data & ML Platform team. This is a critical leadership role where you will build the foundational systems that enable the entire organization to make smarter, faster decisions.

Job Description

As the Engineering Manager for Data & ML Platform (m/f/d), you'll play a vital role in Flink's success. You'll lead a cross-functional engineering team that builds and maintains the data infrastructure and machine learning platform powering data-driven decision making across Flink, from data pipelines and warehousing to ML model training, deployment, and monitoring. You'll work closely with data scientists, platform engineers, analysts, and product teams to enable self-service Data access and accelerate ML adoption company-wide.


 * Lead & Grow Engineers: Build high-trust environments where engineers thrive, with accountability for hiring, onboarding, and performance management while ensuring each team member has a clear career path and receives regular, actionable feedback. **Help your team get 1% better every day**.
 * Drive Product & Business Impact: Partner with Data Science and Analytics to shape initiatives that unlock fast and self-service Data Platform, power ML models, and enable teams across Flink to make faster, better decisions.
 * Own Critical Systems: Lead teams managing data pipelines, data warehouse architecture, ML training infrastructure, feature stores, and model serving systems that form the foundation of Flink's data-driven capabilities.
 * Guide Technical Direction: Shape the technology strategy for Data & ML Platform, lead the architectural decisions and RFC discussions, and champion reliability, data quality, and pragmatic engineering, with customers as our first priority.
 * Champion Reliability & Observability: Set operational excellence standards through SLIs/SLOs, monitoring, and incident response for critical data systems. Lead blameless postmortems, driving continuous improvement.
 * Reduce Toil & Accelerate Delivery: Invest in automating pipelines, reducing overhead by being ahead, and building self-service capabilities that empower data consumers and maintain sustainable velocity.
 * Foster Strong Engineering Culture: Create an environment where the best idea wins. Embody our values by supporting team members, celebrating achievements, and never letting another Flinker fail.
 * Cultivate a Data-First Mindset: Ensure the team prioritizes data quality, privacy compliance (GDPR), and responsible ML practices to protect customer trust.
 * Partner Across Flink: Collaborate with peer Engineering Managers to share learnings and improve engineering practices, driving data literacy organization-wide.
   
   

Qualifications

We're looking for a leader who is passionate about building scalable data infrastructure, ML platforms, and even stronger teams. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited by the challenge of enabling data-driven decision-making at scale.


 * Demonstrated people leadership with a track record of building high-performing data or platform engineering teams
 * Direct experience operating data platforms at scale, including data pipelines, warehousing (e.g., BigQuery), and orchestration tools, preferably Apache Airflow
 * Strong technical foundation in distributed systems, data engineering, and platform architecture
 * Proven experience with cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Kubernetes, GCP, Terraform)
 * Experience with ML infrastructure components such as feature stores (e.g. Feast), model registries, and ML serving systems
 * Experience running high-reliability data services with observability and data quality practices
 * Clear communication, translating technical challenges into a business context
   
   

Nice to have


 * Experience with AI tools like Claude Code for development acceleration
 * Hands-on experience with ML serving frameworks and MLOps tools (e.g., Kserve, MLflow)
 * Background in real-time streaming systems (e.g., Google Pub/Sub, Dataflow)
 * Experience with data governance, privacy regulations (GDPR), and data cataloging
 * Experience with dbt Cloud or dbt Core for data transformation
 * E-commerce, marketplace, or quick commerce familiarity
   
   

Additional Information

title: Data Engineer - Yoshi en (all genders)

Profil


 * 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analysis, Data Science, Data Architecture, or similar roles involving complex data pipelines.
 * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
 * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL and proven experience building ETL pipelines.
 * Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Datastream.
 * Experience with dbt (including testing) and Prefect for orchestration.
 * Solid understanding of broader technical infrastructure and how a data platform integrates with other systems (e.g., martech, APIs, reporting tools).
 * Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently.
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
   
   

Nice to have

contact information

Daniel Sypli

Sr. Talent Acquisition Manager

About Us

NVision is a quantum biotech startup based in Ulm, Germany, with Tier 1 investors from the USA and Europe. We are just leaving stealth mode, moving from local R&D to global commercialization and expansion.

We are developing a technology that will enable MRI-based imaging of real-time metabolism in the body, with tremendous potential for research and applications in oncology, cardiology, neurology and more. Our company brings together expertise in physics, chemistry, engineering and medicine, and we are collaborating with scientists and clinicians from top medical and research centers such as Memorial Sloan Kettering in New York, MD Anderson in Texas, Technical University of Munich, Cambridge University in the UK and more.

NVision is developing fast, robust and easy-to-use hyperpolarization technology for preclinical and clinical research in our POLARIS product line.
